_comment: Everything shown on Settings > About lives here, so it can be edited
without touching code. Leave a field as an empty string to hide it from
the page entirely — nothing here is required.
Bump `version` when you tag a release, and keep it matching the git tag
(with or without a leading 'v'); the update check compares this against
To edit without rebuilding the image, bind-mount your own copy and point
LOCALCHANNELS_ABOUT at it — see the About section of the README.
name: LocalChannels
tagline: Your own video library, with channels.
description: A self-hosted web library and player for the videos you already have on disk. Browse by folder, tag and search your collection, resume where you left off, and shuffle a folder or a set of tags into an endless channel.
credits: Built with FastAPI and SQLite. Metadata and thumbnails come from ffmpeg/ffprobe. Colour themes are adapted from Catppuccin, Nord, Rosé Pine, Gruvbox and Tokyo Night.
